text: {"thought": "Governing law is Michigan, which fails P-22 unless the General Counsel approves. The duration of confidentiality is still unchecked against P-10 and P-11, and the Period of Exchange is referenced in segment 24 but I need the text of the period definition. I will read segments 6, 23 and 24.", "action": "read_segments", "args": {"ids": [6, 23, 24]}}

{"thought": "The precedent search found a Chief Technology Officer approval of this same P-11 deviation for employee counterparties, so no new approval request is needed.", "action": "finish", "args": {"decision": "precedent", "approver": "Chief Technology Officer"}}

{"thought": "P-28 applies only when the agreement is governed by United States law, but this NDA is governed by English law (segment 14), so P-28 does not apply. The indefinite term in segment 13 and the English governing law in segment 14 are the candidate findings. Before finishing, I check whether the whistleblower immunity notice rule applies to this employee NDA.", "action": "rule_lookup", "args": {"rule_id": "LAW-DTSA-1833B"}}

{"thought": "No senior counsel precedent exists for this P-11 deviation with partner counterparties, so the deviation must be requested from the Chief Technology Officer. I send the approval request with a one-sentence reason and do not send anything to the counterparty.", "action": "request_approval", "args": {"rule_id": "P-11", "reason": "The draft does not prevent the counterparty from keeping information retained in the unaided memory of its personnel after return or destruction, which deviates from P-11 for a partner counterparty and needs Chief Technology Officer approval."}}

{"thought": "P-21 requires Ohio or Delaware governing law unless the General Counsel approves otherwise, so the Florida governing law is a deviation. Next I check who may approve it.", "action": "approval_matrix_query", "args": {"rule_id": "P-21"}}

{"thought": "The term is two years with a one-year extension, but segment 78 says the duty of confidence for information disclosed during the term runs indefinitely. I need the text of the maximum confidentiality term rule P-19 to decide whether that breaks it.", "action": "rule_lookup", "args": {"rule_id": "P-19"}}

{"thought": "The return search found no clause requiring return or destruction when the agreement ends, so P-06 is an omission. Segment 25 also says the protection continues in perpetuity, so I check the maximum confidentiality term rule P-08 before finishing.", "action": "rule_lookup", "args": {"rule_id": "P-08"}}

{"thought": "The P-13 violation (segment 28 limits confidential information to technical information) and the Belgian governing law deviation from P-21 are noted. The term in segment 18 is three years, so I check the minimum confidentiality term rule P-06 to see whether that is enough.", "action": "rule_lookup", "args": {"rule_id": "P-06"}}
